## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new setter should normalize keys before storage. Mixed-case writes currently cannot be retrieved through `get()`, breaking the cache’s case-insensitive contract.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` makes both `get("ALPHA")` and `get("alpha")` return `None`. The setter stores the original key, while `get()` always looks up `key.lower()`. Normalize the key when storing and add a mixed-case write test; the existing round-trip test only writes a lowercase key. — Callers lose access to mixed-case writes, and differently cased updates can leave an older value visible.
